pie: awis akwabʰyams ā wawakat: kard agʰnutai mai widanti manum akwams agantam.
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: déywoǵenh₁es nos tewh₂téh₂s poh₂imḗn gʷṓm stéh₂yet. kʷósmōd h₁ím stéh₂yet? h₁ím swṓd bʰréh₂tr̥s stéh₂yet. h₁ím h₂éwih₁ h₂ew dh₃yéh₁t tóh₁-kʷe ḱóm píph₃oyh₁tām. h₁ésmey ḱód wéwkōh₂.
english: Of-Divine-Race, a shepherd of our tribe stole a cow. From whom did he steal it? He stole it from his own brother. Let him give it back with a sheep, and let the two drink together. I shall tell him this.

pie: ḱéywe moy wr̥h₁dʰí kúdʰe tḱéysi. wédni h₁épi tḱéymi. h₁eǵóh₂ moy pótnih₂-kʷe h₂éǵrom h₂én h₂érh₃yowos. kúdʰe-kʷe túH tḱéysi? kl̥Hnṓm ḱóymoy tḱéymi.
english: Tell me, friend, where do you dwell? I dwell by the water. There my wife and I plough the field. And you, where do you dwell? I dwell in a village of the hills.

pie: kʷíh₁ ǵérh₂ont ḱéh₂ h₁éwks? ḱléwsom ménos-kʷe moy bʰéwdʰet. polh₁úns ḱóymons pér stéygʰom h₁éysōm-kʷe deywóns widóm. nu h₁íns pér stéygʰōh₂. h₂uksdʰí pós-kʷe gʷh₂dʰí.
english: Elder, how did you learn these things? I listened, and my mind was awake. I walked through many villages and saw their gods. Then I shall walk through them! Grow up, and afterwards go!

pie: méh₂ter moy wr̥h₁dʰí kʷíh₁ wiHróm ǵn̥néh₃oh₂ h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti. h₁ésyo ǵʰóstoh₁ spéḱye. h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti tósyo ǵʰóstoh₁ tr̥mtés. h₁yód-kʷe h₁ésyo ǵʰóstoh₁ ne trémetes? nu dʰúgh₂ter h₁ím mē sékʷeth₂e.
english: Mother, tell me, how shall I know a man who deceives? Look at his hands. The hands of one who deceives tremble. And if his hands do not tremble? Then do not follow him, daughter!

pie: ph₂ter kóryos h₁éǵʰs h₁éyti h₁ím sékʷōh₂er. ne h₁eh₁lówdʰth₂e. Hwérdʰm̥ ǵʰoysós-kʷe moy HeHḱús. méh₂tr̥h₁ toy ḱósmi ǵʰiméni sddʰí. h₁eǵóh₂ te pós wédʰōh₂.
english: Father, the troop is going out; I shall follow it. You are not grown. I have grown strong, and my spear is swift. Sit with your mother this winter! Afterwards I myself shall lead you.

pie: h₂nŕ̥menes h₁énos h₁léwdʰis kʷyéh₁tim h₂isḱéti. dʰrugʰyónti nos? ne wóydh₂e. bʰoydʰéh₂m nos dédeh₃onti. nu h₁íh₂m̥ h₁áyomesdʰh₂ gʷowsth₂óns-kʷe péh₂somes. h₁yós bʰebʰówdʰe só ne bʰebʰóyh₂e.
english: Man-Minded, that people yonder seeks peace. Are they deceiving us? I do not know. They will give us an oath. Then let us receive it and guard the cow-stalls. He who is alert is not afraid.

pie: kʷíh₁ mléwHmi? ǵérh₂ontes ḱóymoy ḱóm sédyonti. ǵérh₂ontes ḱóymoy ḱóm sédyonti. kóryosyo wékʷesh₂ bʰh₂énti. gʷm̥dʰí ḱléwse-kʷe.
english: How do I say this? The elders are sitting together in the village. The elders are sitting together in the village. They are speaking words of war. Come and listen!

pie: h₁súh₁eḱwe tewh₂téh₂ kénketi. h₁éḱwons moréyōmes? h₁íns mē moréyete. ń̥h₁eḱweh₂ tewh₂téh₂ néḱt. nu kʷíd h₁édomes? gʷĺ̥h₂nons h₁édte h₂ówins-kʷe pékʷete.
english: Of-Good-Horses, the tribe is hungry. Shall we kill the horses? Do not kill them! A horseless tribe is lost. Then what shall we eat? Eat acorns, and cook the sheep.

pie: swésor h₁énos h₁léwdʰis ḱód wérh₁yeti. h₁éḱwons nos wos dh₃té. h₁íns ne déh₃owos. h₁éyes nos h₂éwgmn̥. nu kóryoh₁ gʷm̥yṓnti. gʷm̥yóyh₁ent. wiHrṓs nos ne dedwiyḗr.
english: Sister, that people yonder is saying this: "Give us your horses!" We shall not give them. They are our strength. Then they will come with war. Let them come! Our men are not afraid.

pie: swésor poh₂imnés dʰugh₂térm̥ kl̥Héni h₁épi widóm. h₁íh₂m̥ lubʰyóh₂ pótnih₂ moy bʰuHyéh₁t. kʷód h₁wédmn̥ h₁ésyeh₂s ph₂tḗr h₂isḱéti? déḱm̥ gʷṓs h₂isḱéti. tód polh₁ú. h₁uséwih₂ pótnih₂ démey priHéh₂ h₁wédmn̥ déh₃omes.
english: Sister, I saw the daughter of a shepherd on the hill. I love her; may she become my wife. What bride price does her father seek? He seeks ten cows. That is much! A good wife is dear to a household; we shall give the bride price.

pie: bʰréh₂ter h₁énosyo h₁ludʰéys h₁éḱwōs HeHḱéwes. h₁íns nékʷti stéh₂yōmes. h₁éysōm ḱwónes nékʷti bʰéwdʰonti h₂néres-kʷe nos h₁r̥h₁pyṓnti. dedwóyth₂e? ne dedwóyh₂e méh₂term̥ nos memónh₂e. kʷís h₁íh₂m̥ h₂élēti h₁yód méromes.
english: Brother, the horses of that people yonder are swift. Let us steal them at night! Their dogs are awake at night, and the men will seize us. Are you afraid? I am not afraid; I remember our mother. Who will feed her if we die?

pie: kʷíh₁ méh₂ter ǵr̥h₂n̥tbʰís h₂roh₁dʰéyōh₂? ḱl̥nudʰí pós-kʷe h₂roh₁dʰéye. mē HréwdHs. h₁yód-kʷe me ne ḱléwonti? nu toy wókʷm̥ tl̥nh₂dʰí. h₁uséws wiHrósyo wékʷesos ḱlutóm.
english: Mother, how shall I speak with the elders? Listen, and afterwards speak! Do not cry out! And if they do not hear me? Then lift your voice! The word of a good man is heard.

pie: ǵŕ̥h₂enti moy bʰréh₂tēr gʰrémeti. kʷíd gʰrémeti? h₁ésyo h₁éḱwom h₁épm̥ h₁ím-kʷe h₂éǵrom h₁élh₂m̥. h₁ésmey h₁ím h₂ew wodʰéye ḱéyweh₂-kʷe wékʷesh₂ mluHdʰí. gʰrémontes suHnéwes dṓm h₁éwsonti.
english: Old woman, my brother is angry. Why is he angry? I took his horse and drove it to the field. Lead it back to him, and say friendly words. Raging sons burn down a house.

pie: kʷíd toy príHe h₁nómn̥? h₁eǵóh₂ deywóḱlewēs. ph₂tḗr moy méǵʰye tód h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t. ḱléwos toy méǵh₂? ḱléwos moy ne méǵh₂ ḱwónes moy polh₁éwes. kʷíd-kʷe toy h₁nómn̥? h₁eǵóh₂ h₁suh₁éḱwos.
english: Friend, what is your name? I am Fame-from-the-Gods. My father set that name on me. Is your fame great? My fame is not great; my dogs are many! And what is your name? I am Of-Good-Horses.

pie: kʷíd swésor ḱléwos? h₁íd tód h₁léwdʰis h₁yód ḱlush₁yéti. h₂nḗr mért h₁ésyo h₁nómn̥ ne mért. kʷíh₁ méǵh₂ ḱléwos wénoh₂? h₁léwdʰim h₂lékse gʰostíbʰos-kʷe dedh₃dʰí.
english: Sister, what is fame? It is that which the people hear. A man dies; his name does not die. How shall I win great fame? Protect the people, and give to guests.

pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: kʷíd ǵŕ̥h₂enti ph₂wéni h₁épi sédyesi? h₁eǵóh₂ ǵr̥h₂éntih₂ péh₂wr̥-kʷe gʷʰréh₁yeti. h₁idʰé sddʰí lewbʰéh₂-kʷe toy wékʷesh₂ wéwkōh₂. h₁íh₂ moy wéwke. h₁yós ḱléwseti só polh₁úh₂ wóyde. h₁yós h₂roh₁dʰéyeti só kʷid ne ḱléwt.
english: Old woman, why are you sitting by the fire? I am old, and the fire is warm. Sit down here, and I will tell you dear words. Tell them to me! He who listens knows many things. He who talks hears nothing.

pie: h₃réǵ tewh₂téh₂ kóryōd ḱémh₂t. h₁íd ǵn̥néh₃mi. dusméneses nos h₁éḱwons péruti h₁pént. h₁íns h₂ew dh₃ih₁ént kʷyéh₁tis-kʷe h₁syéh₁t. príHe toy wṓkʷs h₁uséwih₂. h₁íns h₂usési h₁r̥sḱḗsi.
english: King, the tribe has grown tired from the war. I know it. Hostile men took our horses last year. Let them give them back, and let there be peace. Your speech is good, friend. At dawn I shall go to them.

pie: swésor nos dómn̥s kl̥Héni démōmes. kʷíd h₁íns h₂én démōmes? h₁yós gʷm̥sḱéti tóm upér spéḱyomes. wódr̥ h₂én ne h₁ésti. wódr̥ upó bʰérōmes. nu tewh₂téh₂h₁ h₂roh₁dʰéyōmes.
english: Sister, let us build our houses on the hill. Why shall we build them there? Whoever comes, we see him from above. There is no water there. We shall carry the water up. Then let us speak with the people.

pie: h₂ówis, (H)yésmin h₂wlh₂néh₂ ne éh₁est, dedorḱe (h₁)éḱwons, tóm, wóǵʰom gʷérh₂um wéǵʰontm, tóm, bʰórom méǵoh₂m, tóm, dʰǵʰémonm h₂oHḱú bʰérontm.
english: A sheep that had no wool saw horses, one of them pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly.

pie: swésor péh₂wr̥ kl̥Héni h₁épi kʷéḱm̥. dusméneses h₁íd dʰégʷʰonti h₁éysōm kóryos gʷm̥sḱéti. h₂nérn̥s drémoh₂? moḱs gʷh₂dʰí h₁éymos-kʷe wéwke gʷm̥sḱónti. ḱwn̥bʰís h₁idʰé sth₂éh₁yōh₂.
english: Sister, I caught sight of a fire on the hill. Hostile men are burning it; their troop is coming. Shall I run to the men? Go quickly, and tell them: they are coming. I shall stand here with the dogs.

pie: ǵérh₂ont kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí. bʰéwdʰesi? bʰéwdʰoh₂ ǵérh₂ontes nékʷti bʰéwdʰonti. kúdʰe moḱs ih₂tés? h₂éǵrom yéh₂mi h₂érh₃yōh₂. gʷh₂dʰí dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe toy méh₂tēr h₁suménēs h₁syéh₁t.
english: Be well, old man! Are you awake? I am awake; old men are awake at night. Where are you going so early? I am going to the field; I shall plough. Go, and may Earth, the mother, be kindly to you!

pie: déywoḱlewes moy wr̥h₁dʰí kʷíd wiHrós dʰéh₁t. h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰént. h₁ésyo ḱérh₂sonm̥ swóh₁ ǵʰoysóh₁ bʰéydt wédōr-kʷe mélh₃t. bʰéyh₂t? ne bʰéyh₂t h₁ésyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom.
english: Fame-from-the-Gods, tell me what the hero did. He slew the serpent. He split its head with his spear, and the waters came forth. Did he grow afraid? He did not grow afraid; his fame is imperishable.

pie: pótni kéh₂ileh₂ h₁sdʰí. gʰóstey gʷm̥dʰí priHós-kʷe nos h₁sdʰí. kʷís túH kʷósyeh₂s-kʷe tewh₂téh₂s h₁ési. h₁eǵóh₂ kl̥Hnṓm tewh₂téh₂s poh₂imḗn. ph₂wéni h₁épi sddʰí h₁ddʰí-kʷe ph₃dʰí-kʷe. túH moy ḱéyweh₂.
english: Be well, mistress! Come, guest, and be dear to us! Who are you, and from which tribe are you? I am a shepherd from a tribe of the hills. Sit down by the fire, and eat, and drink. You are dear to me.

pie: kúdʰe h₁wésuḱlewes gʷṓs ǵʰiméni h₂éǵōmes? h₁íns kólHonm̥ h₂éǵe. h₂éǵros h₂én ǵʰelh₃wós? h₁éy ǵʰelh₃wós wĺ̥kʷōs-kʷe ní ne gʷm̥yónti. nu h₁íns h₂usési wédʰōh₂. gʷh₂dʰí deywṓs-kʷe te ph₂sih₁ént.
english: Of-Goodly-Fame, where shall we drive the cattle in winter? Drive them to the hill! Is the pasture green there? It is green, and the wolves do not come down. Then I shall lead them at dawn. Go, and may the gods guard you!

pie: ph₂ter kóryoh₁ h₂usési h₁éymi. súHnew gʷh₂dʰí n̥smé-kʷe h₂ew gʷm̥té. mē bʰéwgs. pérkʷunos te ph₂syéh₁t ḱléwos-kʷe toy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁syéh₁t. wékʷesh₂ toy memónh₂e.
english: Father, at dawn I go with the troop. Go, son, and come back to us. Do not flee! May Perkwunos guard you, and may your fame be imperishable. I keep your words in mind.

pie: h₁súḱlewes kóryom memónth₂e? h₁ím memónh₂e bʰréh₂tēr moy h₁ésmi séngʷt. kʷís h₁ím gʷʰént? gʰóstis h₁ím ǵʰoysóh₁ gʷʰént. nu moy ḱḗr kʷih₁téy h₁ésti. deywṓs toy h₁wésuh₂ dh₃ih₁ént.
english: Of-Good-Fame, do you remember the war? I remember it; my brother fell in it. Who killed him? A stranger killed him with a spear. Now my heart is at peace. May the gods give you good things!
